findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no paper towels at the hand washing sink. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) placed paper towels at the hand washing sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are used for handwashing only, and are always supplied with warm running water, soap, and paper towels.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed facility’s sanitizer bottle “bleaching out”- meaning the concentration of Chlorine bleach in the bottle was at a concentration greater than 200ppm. CORRECTED- the bottle was diluted to an approved concentration of 200ppm. Ensure sanitizing solutions intended for food contact surfaces are at a concentration recommended by the manufacturer's label (50-200 ppm in the case of Cl bleach).
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an open container of half and half creamer with no date marking. The PIC did not know when the container was opened. CORRECTED- the PIC voluntarily discarded the half and half. Ensure all temperature control for food safety items (TCS) are marked with the date they are open are prepared. TCS items must be used or discarded within seven days after opening; with the day they are opened counted as day one.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).[P]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a bottle containing a clear liquid to have no label. CORRECTED- PIC labeled the bottle as “bleach.” Ensure bottle containing clear liquids are labeled with their contents if they are taken from their original container to avoid potential contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11 Common Name. Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. [Pf]
